page_title: MON 2-2 LOR | Monaco v Lorient 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Lorient take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+4' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) bravely launches himself at a cross from Imran Louza and gives Radoslaw Majecki no chance with a close-range bullet header into the top right corner. 2:2.
90+4' Imran Louza (Lorient) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. Lorient will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+2' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
89' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
89' Today's match ends for Aleksandr Golovin who will be replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.
84' The resulting set piece from Lorient is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Lorient are awarded a corner kick.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is replacing Maghnes Akliouche.
83' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Wissam Ben Yedder is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
82' Here comes a substitution. Panos Katseris (Lorient) is brought on as a substitute for Theo Le Bris.
81' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is awarded a second yellow by Bastien Dechepy and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) for Mohamed Bamba.
76' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Laurent Abergel and he is replaced by Imran Louza (Lorient).
76' That will be all from Takumi Minamino who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).

75' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Radoslaw Majecki pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
71' Formose Mendy (Lorient) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
69' Here is a change. Julien Ponceau is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) comes onto the pitch so that Ayman Kari can be given a rest.
66' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

65' Yvon Mvogo pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper. Monaco will take a corner kick.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Denis Zakaria (Monaco) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' 2 - 1 Goal! Aleksandr Golovin produces a brilliant lofted pass and Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 2:1.
60' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
51' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
51' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
50' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ismail Jakobs (Monaco). The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

49' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. Now Monaco have a corner.
48' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

47' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Yvon Mvogo to get hold of the ball. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The game is over for Kassoum Ouattara. Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) comes on for the second half.
46' Referee Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' That was a nice football moment. Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Radoslaw Majecki guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
42' Lorient couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
42' Bastien Dechepy interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
39' Ayman Kari (Lorient) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
37' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) is able to continue to play.
35' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is adjudged offside.
33' It looks like Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) saw red with that tackle. Bastien Dechepy won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
27' 1 - 1 Formose Mendy (Lorient) was unlucky to score an own goal attempting to intercept a cross. Hang your head in shame!
26' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
24' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is penalised for holding. Bastien Dechepy signals a set piece.
20' None of the Monaco players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
15' What a chance that is! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the right post!

14' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Bastien Dechepy with no other option than to blow for a foul.
13' The resulting corner from Takumi Minamino (Monaco) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

10' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Yvon Mvogo was alert and the score remains the same.
8' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
7' The corner kick from Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
6' The resulting corner from Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is cleared by the defence.
5' The resulting corner from Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is cleared.
4' Monaco take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
1' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! Wilfried Singo (Monaco) unluckily beats his own goalkeeper.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lorient will kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy will referee today's match.
